primary.disposition: Shared-Arc administrative cache and synchronous redacted serialization have actual callers; owned administrative projections are outside the request path.
One serial cache worker, final-event compression and synchronous full/partial callbacks under the write lock preserve the accepted publication ordering. No measurement supports replacing this owner.
Bounded type/codec admission, cancellation and relist failure policies are explicit. Generic valid-prefix handling and backend exact withdrawal are distinct required contracts.
Canonical cache exports and conf-sync factory consumers checked.

support_scope: Relevant original contracts, caller/callee and test sections inspected; supporting hashes do not claim complete secondary reads.
limits: Source/static evidence only; no builds, tests, benchmarks or Git mutations. Accepted lifecycle and failure policies preserved.
